title: Plants Vs Zombies: Endless War
description: Deploy Garden Warfare PvZ potted plants that defend you against zombies, raids, bosses, and modded threats.
body:
In honor of the new Endless War update, PvZ Potted Plants has evolved into Plants vs Zombies: Endless War.
This mod is no longer just about potted defenders on peaceful lawns.
It is now a Garden Warfare-style survival defense mod built for zombie apocalypse packs, raid overhauls, bosses, horror mobs, and modded invasion worlds.

**Plants vs Zombies: Endless War adds deployable plant units, roaming plant warriors, support systems, mailbox raid events, and escalating combat encounters for harder Minecraft worlds.**

How To Obtain:
Craft tier seed packets with 8 matching materials around 1 wheat seed.

• Copper Packet: copper ingots

• Iron Packet: iron ingots

• Gold Packet: gold ingots

• Diamond Packet: diamonds

• Netherite Packet: netherite ingots

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b6e7e5866dfe46a3ade225c217727c8821cd1adc.png)


Right-click a tier seed packet to roll 8 slots of plant seed packets. Some slots can be blank. Higher packets have better odds for stronger plants but can still roll lower-tier plants.


**Meet the Plants:**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

**Lightning Reed:** 
Fast electric defender. Chains lightning between enemies and uses a close blast when mobs get too near.

**Bamboo Shoot:**
Mortar plant. Fires upward, then drops airstrike projectiles from above.

**Scaredy Shroom:** 
Long-range sniper. Only shoots targets it can see, then hides when threatened.

**Doom Shroom:**
Massive explosive plant. Charges, floats, then releases a huge blast with heavy knockback.

**Ice Shroom:**
Fast freeze bomb. Damages enemies, fully freezes them, then leaves lingering slowness.

**Heal Flower:**
Support plants and owner players. Produces healing suns that restore nearby damaged plants and owner players.

**Gatling Pea:** 
High-DPS turret. Continuously fires rapid pea rounds at visible targets.

**Pea Cannon:**
AOE cannon plant. Fires large peas that deal direct damage and splash damage.

**Fume Shroom:** 
Piercing anti-armor plant. Sprays fumes that pass through multiple enemies and ignore armor.

**Goop Shroom:** 
Control plant. Fires goop shots that damage, slow, and poison enemies.

**Toxic Gloom Shroom:**
Area poison plant. Releases dense toxic mist around itself, damaging and poisoning enemies.

**Hypno Shroom:**
Roaming chaos plant. Jumps around enemies, infects them with debuffs, leeches life when injured, and can make targets lose control.

**Bonk Choy:**
Close-range brawler. Punches rapidly in a barrage combo and can launch enemies with left-hand hits.

**Power Lily:**
Boost support plant. Links to nearby plants and empowers them with Plant Boost.

</details>


**Meet the Weeds:**

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Weeds are roaming plant soldiers with multiple equipment states.

**Default Weed:**
A mobile fighter that can spit seeds, whip enemies, and temporarily protect itself with vase armor.

**Shield Weed:**
Give a Weed a shield to turn it into a shield-bearing frontline unit with extra armor.

**Potted Weed:**
Give a Weed a flower pot to add a separate armor shell.

**Banner Weed:**
Give a Weed a banner to turn it into a commander. Banner Weeds can rally nearby allied Weeds, heal allies with suns, follow the owner, stay near a matching placed banner, or patrol like a captain.

**Dandelion Bombs:**
Banner Weeds can conjure Dandelion Weed bombs that chase their target and explode.

</details>


**Mailbox Raid System.**

Mailboxes are functional blocks used for raid letters.
Place a mailbox and wait.
Every few Minecraft days, it can receive a rolled raid message.
When mail is inside, the mailbox changes state and shows a floating mail indicator.
Reading a raid letter starts a custom raid after a short delay.
Raids use 10 waves, scale in difficulty, and pull hostile mobs from vanilla and modded content.
Zombies, undead mobs, illagers, and other monsters can all appear depending on the wave.
Raid letters are designed to make the war feel endless, not like a one-time event.

![Raid Message](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38db2eb8268ba408e961d9bae1710e467ed1a91c_0.webp)


Why Use This Mod?

This mod is made for dangerous modpacks where normal defenses are not enough: zombie apocalypse, raid overhaul, boss survival, horror, invasion, and war-based packs.
Plants are strong, automatic, owner-aware, and built for frontlines, bases, arenas, colonies, and long survival worlds.

Notes:

• Plants placed by a player become owned by that player.

• Plants can be shoveled by any types of shovel for transport.

• Owned plants defend their owner.

• Plants with the same owner avoid friendly fire.

• Potted plants can be placed on valid plantable blocks, including lily pads.

• Most plants are stationary, while Hypno Shroom and Weeds can roam.

• Mailboxes can receive raid letters over time.

• You must remove my previous mod called: [Lightning Reed Potted Plant mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/lightning-reed-potted-plant) if you have it installed.
